assumptions: Let A be a unital complex C*-algebra, H a complex Hilbert space, and π a unital representation of A on H. Competing nonzero irreducible representations are quantified through the nonunital representation interface; irreducibility supplies the associated unital representations used in the comparison.
conclusion: The representation π is a representative of the unique unitary-equivalence class of nonzero irreducible representations of A, with competitors quantified through the nonunital representation interface. Faithfulness and separability are not part of the definition.
definition_equation: IsSingletonIrreducibleModelAmongNonUnital π ↔ IsIrreducible π ∧ ∀ K ρ, IsIrreducible ρ → UnitaryEquivalent π (ρ.toUnital ...).
definition_explanation: IsSingletonIrreducibleModelAmongNonUnital π ↔ IsIrreducible π ∧ ∀ K ρ, IsIrreducible ρ → UnitaryEquivalent π (ρ.toUnital ...).
display_title: Unital representative of the unique irreducible-representation class

name: MathlibAnnex.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Representation.IsSingletonIrreducibleModelAmongNonUnital
natural_language_statement: Let A be a unital complex C*-algebra, H a complex Hilbert space, and π a unital representation of A on H. The representation π is a representative of the unique unitary-equivalence class of nonzero irreducible representations of A: π is irreducible, and for every nonzero irreducible representation ρ presented through the nonunital representation interface, π is unitarily equivalent to the associated unital representation ρ.toUnital. Faithfulness and separability are not part of the definition.
one_sentence_role: Defines the corresponding condition for a unital representation, with competing nonzero irreducible representations quantified through the nonunital representation interface.

IsSingletonIrreducibleModelAmongNonUnital π ↔ IsIrreducible π ∧ ∀ K ρ, IsIrreducible ρ → UnitaryEquivalent π (ρ.toUnital ...).

The source quantifies K and ρ independently as a nonunital star-homomorphism, assumes ρ.IsIrreducible, and uses ρ.toUnital in the comparison. This differs from merely possessing a separable faithful representation.
